name: FREA
description: German freelancer invoicing compliance — validates invoices against §14 UStG, GoBD, and MwSt-per-line-item rules. Provides legal requirement resources and a validation tool for AI assistants.

tools.name: frea:validate_invoice
tools.description: Validates a proposed invoice against German legal requirements (§14 UStG, GoBD, MwSt per line item). Returns compliance status, violations, suggestions, and calculated VAT total.

resources.description: §14 UStG compliance reference — mandatory invoice fields, MwSt calculation rules, GoBD requirements, Kleinunternehmer §19 UStG, Reverse Charge.
Step-by-step onboarding checklist for setting up FREA (Stammdaten, Client, Invoice, Audit-Log, ZUGFeRD).
